rows.text: calls `001802E0` + 0x8 and, when it returns null, clears `xmm0` and returns; otherwise calls it again (`001802E0` + 0x12) and tail-jumps (`001802E0` + 0x21) with the returned pointer in `rcx` and the incoming `ecx` in `edx`
calls `001803A0` + 0x4 and returns its null result unchanged; otherwise calls it again (`001803A0` + 0xE) and returns 1 when byte `+0x3D8` of the returned pointer is non-zero, else 0
calls `00180430` + 0x4 and returns its null result unchanged; otherwise calls it again (`00180430` + 0xE) and returns 1 when byte `+0x80` of the returned pointer is non-zero, else 0

returns 0 when the call at `001804A0` + 0x8 returns null or when byte `+0x80` of the pointer from the call at `001804A0` + 0x12 is zero; otherwise passes the pointer from a third call (`001804A0` + 0x22) in `rcx` and the incoming `ecx` in `edx` to the call at `001804A0` + 0x2C and returns 1 when that returns a non-zero `al`, else 0

returns 0 when the call at `001804F0` + 0x8 returns null; otherwise, on the pointer p from the call at `001804F0` + 0x12, walks the nodes from qword `p+0x100`, keeping the last node whose dword `+0x20` is not less than `ecx` (signed) and following its qword `+8`, else following qword `+0`, until null; returns 1 when a node was kept and the incoming `ecx` is not less than its dword `+0x20` (so the two are equal), and 0 when the result is `p+0xF0`

calls `00180560` + 0xF and returns its null result unchanged; otherwise takes a flag that is 1 when byte `+0x1C` of the result of the call at `00180560` + 0x23 is non-zero, and calls `00180560` + 0x42 with the pointer from the call at `00180560` + 0x32 in `rcx`, the flag in `edx`, the incoming `ecx` in `r8d` and the incoming `rdx` in `r9`, returning 1 when that returns a non-zero `al`, else 0

when `rdx` differs from `rcx`, makes the array of 8-byte elements at `rcx` (qwords `+0` begin, `+8` end, `+0x10` capacity end, object at `+0x18`) hold the elements of `rdx`'s array: when their count exceeds the capacity (unsigned) it allocates count times 8 bytes through vtable slot `+0x10` of the `+0x18` object (null for count 0), copies through the indirect call at `0019DDD0` + 0x78, releases a non-null old block through slot `+0x18` and sets `+0` and `+0x10`; otherwise it copies in place (`0019DDD0` + 0xCD then + 0xF7 when the count exceeds the current size, only + 0xF7 otherwise); then sets `+8` to begin plus count times 8; returns `rcx`

with the pointer array at `rcx+0xF0` (qwords `+0xF0` begin, `+0xF8` end, `+0x100` capacity end), when `edx` minus the element count is non-negative, repeats that difference plus one times: a 0x48-byte allocation (`001AC810` + 0x75) that, when non-null, goes through the call at `001AC810` + 0xB9 with the current count in `edx`, 80.0 (`008F6D58`) in `xmm2`, 2.0 (`01CEBC08`) in `xmm3` and stack arguments 60.0 (`008F6D54`), 1, 0.0 and 6, and whose result (or null) is stored at the end and the end advanced by 8 when below capacity, else appended through the call at `001AC810` + 0xF4; then stores `edx` into dword `+0x38` of element `edx` and returns that element

reads the displacement d from dword `+4` of the table that qword `rcx-0x98` points to, stores `00900FA0` into the qword at `rcx-0x98+d` and d minus 0x98 into the dword at `rcx-0x9C+d`, stores `00900F20` into qword `rcx-0x80`, passes `rcx-0x80` to the call at `001DE280` + 0x50 and to the indirect call at `001DE280` + 0x59, and tail-jumps through the indirect jump at `001DE280` + 0x6D with `rcx-0x78`
calls `001E0360` + 0x15 with `rcx+0x18`, the incoming `rdx`, `r8` and `r9`, and 0 as the fifth (stack) argument, and returns the incoming `rdx`

takes the 0x18-byte record at `02EBB700` indexed by 1 minus dword `02EBB730` and writes two 16-byte entries at its qword `+8` cursor, advancing it by 0x10 each (the first holds dwords 0x10000000, 0, 0, 0x10000000; the second qword 0x70000000 and qword 0); then returns when dword `+0x14` of the record is non-zero, else tail-jumps (`00465FF0` + 0x72) with `ecx` 0, the record in `rdx` and `r8` 0

calls `00466070` + 0x11 with `ecx` 0 and passes its result in `rcx`, with `edx` and `r8d` 0, to the call at `00466070` + 0x1E; stores 0 into dword `02EBB730`; then, when `edx` is non-negative, calls `00466070` + 0x3E with `02EBB700`, the incoming `rcx` and `edx`, and tail-jumps (`00466070` + 0x5B) with `02EBB718`, the incoming `rcx` and `ecx` plus `edx`; when `edx` is negative, calls `00466070` + 0x60 with `02EBB700` and the incoming `rcx` and tail-jumps (`00466070` + 0x79) with `02EBB718` and the incoming `rcx`
stores 1 minus dword `02EBB730` back into `02EBB730` and, in the 0x18-byte record at `02EBB700` that the new value indexes, copies qword `+0` into qword `+8`
calls `00466120` + 0x6 with `ecx` 0 and tail-jumps (`00466120` + 0x17) with its result in `rcx` and `edx` and `r8d` 0

returns 0 when `ecx` is negative or not less than dword `02EBB6E0` (signed), or when qword `+8` of the 0x50-byte record `ecx` of the array at qword `02EBB6F0` is zero; otherwise returns dword `+0x4C` of that record AND 1

on `rcx`, stores int dword `+0x44` as float times 0.5 (`01CEBB70`) at `+0` and int dword `+0x48` as float times -0.5 (`0090030C`) at `+0x14`; stores float `+0x50` minus float `+0x4C` times -0.5 at `+0x28` and their sum times 0.5 at `+0x38`; zeroes bytes `+4` to `+0x13`, `+0x18` to `+0x27` and dword `+0x2C`; and stores the bit pattern 0x45000000 at `+0x30` and `+0x34` and 0x3F800000 at `+0x3C`

notes: 001804F0: the walk follows +8 on key >= ecx and +0 otherwise; the sentence states only the access pattern, not which child is which. 0019DDD0 and 001DE280: the indirect calls go through import slots (008C2A40, 008C27A0, 008C2518) and are cited by site only; the import names are not decoded in the listing. 00466070: on the negative-edx path r8 is not set before the calls, so the sentence gives only rcx and rdx. 00467940: 0x45000000 and 0x3F800000 are not decoded by the listing, so they are given as bit patterns.
